package.title: The architecture of blockchain value: capabilities, pillars, and growth dynamics
package.data_as_of: The article uses no dataset. Its tables were transcribed in 2026.
package.units: Values are in the article's normalised units, with the value of one capability set to one in the figures; shares and ratios are plain numbers. Nothing here is in dollars.

licence.condition: Reuse of the results is allowed with credit to the paper.
licence.third_party_data: There are no third-party data. The files in data/ are Tables 2 to 6 of the article, transcribed by hand; the article and those tables are under CC BY, the licence of Frontiers in Blockchain.

package.cite_as: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). The architecture of blockchain value: capabilities, pillars, and growth dynamics. Frontiers in Blockchain, 9, 1747512. https://doi.org/10.3389/fbloc.2026.1747512
package.cite_package: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). The architecture of blockchain value: capabilities, pillars, and growth dynamics. Replication package, version 1.1.0. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24404059
package.describe_as: Papadogiannis (2026), "The architecture of blockchain value: capabilities, pillars, and growth dynamics", Frontiers in Blockchain 9, with its replication package.
